hooks.text: 每轮严格运行二十分钟现实时间，世界末日倒计时直接限定整次探索窗口
hooks.excerpt: IMPORTANT : Each run lasts 20 real-time minutes, but exploring the world, uncovering its secrets, and realizing what was possible all along can keep you discovering for much longer.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 剧情散落在社区小事件、支线任务和谜团碎片中，需要靠自由探索拼合
hooks.excerpt: Story through exploration – uncover small moments, side quests, and fragments of mystery woven into the neighborhood.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 没有存档也没有数值升级，唯一跨轮成长是记住世界规律与事件连接
hooks.excerpt: Built with replayability and speedrun in mind – no save system, no upgrades; your only progress is knowledge of how the world works and how everything connects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: ots the graphics thats did the nagic for me
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 收集全部风筝后没有奖励或反馈，令人失望。

excerpts.excerpt: I gathered every single one and never got any reward or acknowledgment for it. That felt disappointing after putting in the extra effort.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 操作手感很差，镜头平滑过强。

excerpts.excerpt: Controls are horrible (THE CAMERA SMOOTHING IS INSANE)
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 对话直接提示谜题解法，削弱发现乐趣。

excerpts.excerpt: discovering them is no fun at all if the dialogues are literally telling you what to do or how to solve puzzles.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 二十分钟循环中的对话与发现鼓励再次探索。

excerpts.excerpt: every conversation, discovery, and missed opportunity encourages you to see the neighborhood differently next time.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 拼凑线索理解故事的过程受到喜爱。

excerpts.excerpt: I personally loved piecing everything together.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 主题表达被认为表面且直白灌输。

excerpts.excerpt: The themes are superficial and plain, and also spoon-fed.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 忧郁、东欧式的怀旧氛围令人舒适且印象深刻。

excerpts.excerpt: The atmosphere is fantastic. It's melancholic, a bit depressing, and somehow captures that distinct Eastern European vibe that makes everything feel nostalgic and strangely comforting at the same time.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
